says.detail:
Drafted.

On 2026-09-12, I slipped on wet steps and fell on my outstretched right hand. I went to the Emergency Unit at University Hospital of Wales, where my wrist was X-rayed. The A&E staff said it was a sprain and sent me home with a bandage and no follow-up. The pain did not go away. On 2026-10-19, my GP sent me for a repeat X-ray and MRI. On 2026-10-26, the MRI showed a displaced scaphoid waist fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed class tests and weeks of shifts at my café job.

My complaint to Cardiff and Vale University Health Board: sent

What Cardiff and Vale University Health Board said: The wrist was examined and X-rayed in line with its procedures, the X-ray was reported as showing no fracture at the time, and it apologised that I had a poor experience. It did not explain why no follow-up was arranged.

Why this is not resolved: I am still unhappy because the provider did not explain why no follow-up was arranged and did not address my need for further care.

Outcome: An explanation, an apology, changes to how A&E checks wrist injuries, and compensation for pain and lost earnings

message:
Dear Public Services Ombudsman for Wales,

I would like you to look at my complaint about Cardiff and Vale University Health Board.

On 2026-09-12, I slipped on wet steps and fell on my outstretched right hand. I went to the Emergency Unit at University Hospital of Wales, where my wrist was X-rayed. The A&E staff said it was a sprain and sent me home with a bandage and no follow-up. The pain did not go away. On 2026-10-19, my GP sent me for a repeat X-ray and MRI. On 2026-10-26, the MRI showed a displaced scaphoid waist fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed class tests and weeks of shifts at my café job.

My complaint to Cardiff and Vale University Health Board: sent

What Cardiff and Vale University Health Board said: The wrist was examined and X-rayed in line with its procedures, the X-ray was reported as showing no fracture at the time, and it apologised that I had a poor experience. It did not explain why no follow-up was arranged.

Why this is not resolved: I am still unhappy because the provider did not explain why no follow-up was arranged and did not address my need for further care.

What I would like: An explanation, an apology, changes to how A&E checks wrist injuries, and compensation for pain and lost earnings

Yours sincerely,
Elin Rhydderch
23 Clos Dychmygol, Cathays, Cardiff, CF24 4QW
07700 900582
